text:
maria: Anyone heading to the farmers' market Saturday morning? thinking 9am at the main square for coffee + stalls

sanjay: I'm down. got new reusable bags :recycle: meet at the fountain?

evan: can we tack on a short ride after? river loop ~12mi, easy pace. helmets mandatory.

leah: pottery class at noon but can do coffee and market till 10:30. what time is the ride?

todd: bringing sourdough starter for show-and-tell if anyone wants a sliver :grin: also might pick up some herbs

maria: fountain at 9 it is. evan — ride leaves ~10:15 so you can join after market. @leah totally fine if you bail for class

evan: route is flat: out river rd > bridge > loop back. pace ~12-13mph. will bring spare tube + pump.

sanjay: after-market plan: i'm making a big pot of roasted tomato soup on Sunday, anyone want leftovers/ to swap for bread? :bowl_with_spoon:

leah: YES please. i'll bring ciabatta if you need bread. also can help with chopping on Sunday morning.

todd: count me in for soup + bread trade. also curious to see that starter in action :camera_with_flash:

maria: recipe? maybe post quick list so people can bring ingredients

sanjay: sure — quick shopping list:
```
- tomatoes (6 large or 2 cans crushed)
- onion, garlic
- basil
- veg stock
- olive oil, salt, pepper
```
can scale easy. will do oven-roasted tomatoes and blend.

maria: perfect. i'll grab basil and stock. meeting recap: 9am market @ fountain, optional river ride 10:15, soup swap Sunday. :thumbsup:

reminder-bot: Reminder for leah — Pottery class check-in at 11:45 on Saturday (you added this event)

evan: o/ see y'all Saturday. bringing spare pump and a portable coffee thermos.

leah: see you — bringing a little jar of glaze samples to show if anyone's curious :)

todd: excited. also if anyone wants a slice of starter, i'll have tiny jars. first-come first-serve :seedling:
